newsitem.title: USA: Tel-Save sees reaching top of '97 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Tel-Save sees reaching top of '97 estimates.

text.p: Tel-Save Holdings Inc said on Thursday the company may be on the "upside" of current analysts' projections for full-year 1997 earnings of $1.00 per share.

The company also said the acquisition of most of the assets of American Business Alliance Inc would be accretive to earnings and significantly increase Tel-Save's capacities to direct market long distance communications services.
The company acquired American Business, a switchless reseller of long distance communications services, for $9.5 million. It also forgave $12.8 million of American Business indebtedness to Tel-Save.
The deal helps the company increase its line growth, possible reaching 300,000 lines by June 1997.
